positions.as_written: Use a cartilage sensitive sequence with a sharp cartilage to fluid interface.
Use the thinnest slices available, because a fissure is narrower than most slice thicknesses.
Confirm in a second plane, because partial volume averaging produces a line in one plane.
Assess whether the thickness is preserved, which is what separates this from a defect.
Fissuring in an asymptomatic compartment is a finding of uncertain significance and should be reported as such.
